title: SignalTracker
description: Tracks the lifecycle of a monitored signal from detection through resolution.

signal_id.description: Unique identifier for this signal, e.g. 'eu-ai-act-enforcement-2025'.

title.description: Short human-readable title for the signal.

signal_markers.description: Optional practical markers that qualify the signal without replacing the primary signal classification.

status.description: Current lifecycle stage of the signal.

region.description: Primary region or geography, if applicable.

sector.description: Primary sector or domain, e.g. sanctions, trade, energy, regulation, AI.

first_detected.description: Date the signal was first identified (YYYY-MM-DD).

last_updated.description: Date of the most recent update to this tracker entry (YYYY-MM-DD).

next_review.description: Suggested date to re-check this signal (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit if no fixed horizon.

summary.description: Current state of the signal in 2-4 sentences. Updated with each development.

developments.description: Chronological log of material updates to this signal.

what_changed.description: What materially changed since the previous entry.

source_note.description: Key sources behind this update, if source-backed.

status_change.description: New lifecycle status if it changed with this update.

watch_indicators.description: Concrete, observable signals that would trigger a status change or escalation.

resolution_note.description: Required when status is 'resolved' or 'archived'. What concluded or why archiving.
